mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and increases S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains low but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which positively impacts the broader economy and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production signals increased economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is low and unemployment rate is high, it indicates a stimulative policy in a weak labor market, leading to increased S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the trigger conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth coupled with high federal funds rate indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the trigger conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, as indicated by CPIAUCSL > 250, high inflation erodes purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL > 250 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment and retail sales indicates a strong economy, leading to increased S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 2% YoY and RSAFS growth > 5% YoY
failure_condition: If the trigger conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.
